content_units: Weekend Watch Shortlist

Best fit for your priorities:   Fleabag  ,   The Bear  , and   Only Murders in the Building  . They’re tightly written, low on filler, mostly under 60 minutes, and easier to finish within your   25-episode monthly cap   than the heavier sci-fi/mystery options.
Ranked Fit for Your Preferences
Rank   Series   Why it fits   Episode length / commitment   Main tradeoff
1     Fleabag     Exceptionally sharp writing, almost zero filler, very easy to finish   12 episodes total, about 25–30 min each   Emotionally intense at points, but not bleak overall
2     The Bear     Elite writing, urgent pacing, highly bingeable, mostly short episodes   18 episodes across first 2 seasons, about 30–40 min each   Stressful more than depressing
3     Only Murders in the Building     Clever, light, entertaining, accessible tone, good mystery momentum   10 episodes per season, about 30–40 min each   Slightly more uneven than top 2
4     Severance     Outstanding writing and concept, very compelling, little obvious filler   9 episodes in season 1, about 45–57 min each   More unsettling and emotionally cold
5     Mindhunter     Excellent writing and performances, very strong craft   19 episodes across 2 seasons, about 35–60 min each   Clearly darker and more draining than your ideal

6     Dark     Brilliantly written and ambitious, but least aligned to “not too depressing” and easy-commit pacing   26 episodes total, about 45–60 min each   Dense, bleak, and exceeds your 25-episode cap if completed
Best-Fit Notes by Show
Option 1:   Fleabag     Best overall match for strong writing + minimal filler + low time commitment     Fastest high-quality finish
View series
Option 2:   The Bear     Best if you want something current, intense, and addictive without long episodes     High stress, low filler
View series
Option 3:   Only Murders in the Building     Best if you want the least emotionally heavy option with a fun mystery hook     Most comfortable watch
View series
Option 4:   Severance     Best prestige pick if you want a more thought-provoking, eerie watch     Highest concept
View series
Tradeoffs That Matter Most
Why Fleabag is  1
- It best matches   strong writing   and   minimal filler  .
- The short run means you can finish it comfortably this month and still start something else.
- It has emotional depth, but it’s more   witty and piercing   than depressing.
Why The Bear is  2
- It’s one of the strongest-written shows here and wastes almost no time.
- Episode lengths are very friendly for weekend watching.
- The catch: it can feel   anxious and chaotic  , so if “not too depressing” also means “not too stressful,” it drops slightly behind Fleabag.
Why Only Murders lands at  3
- It’s the easiest recommendation if your top concern is avoiding anything too heavy.
- The mystery/comedy tone makes it a relaxed start for a weekend.
- It’s not quite as razor-sharp as Fleabag or The Bear, but it’s the safest mood fit.
Why Severance is lower than its quality suggests
- Pure quality-wise, it could rank higher.
- But your preferences penalize its   heavier mood   and near-60-minute episodes.
- Great pick if you want something immersive, less ideal if you want emotional lightness.
Why Mindhunter and Dark fall back
-   Mindhunter   is excellent but notably dark.
-   Dark   is brilliant, but it’s the least casual and least compatible with your monthly episode limit.
- Both ask for more mental energy than your shortlist criteria suggest.
What I’d Start This Weekend
-   Pick Fleabag   if you want the strongest all-around fit.
-   Pick The Bear   if you want intensity and momentum.
-   Pick Only Murders in the Building   if you want the most enjoyable low-heaviness option.
